skills.description: Triggers when a user provides a pet side-view walking video URL or file for analysis; uses AI pose estimation to track limb joint trajectories, analyzes stride length, stance phase / swing phase duration, and left-right symmetry indicators, and identifies abnormal gait such as lameness or restricted joint mobility.
